channel.description: Recent content in Agents on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
item.description:
Starting in August 2026, Azure Copilot will let customers interact directly with agents to move from questions to actions faster. Users can choose the agent best suited to their goal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: How we built ThinkingBox to measure whether agents finish the job
item.description:
ThinkingBox splits the execution framework from the benchmark package so each can be updated independently. The article frames this as a way to measure whether agents actually finish tasks.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace is now a new channel for discovering, evaluating, and purchasing Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents. The availability applies to Dragon Copilot customers in the United States.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: From single call to agents: five new Claude capabilities now available in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now supports five new Claude capabilities on Azure-hosted models: structured outputs, web search, web fetch, MCP connector, and tool search. The update positions a model endpoint for agent-style workflows rather than single-call usage.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 10
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s August 10 weekly release adds new models, portable plugins, and workflow improvements for agents. The updates are aimed at making Copilot more flexible across editors, the command line, and the Copilot app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: Building Agents that Act on Your Behalf with Toolboxes in Foundry
item.description:
Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry are presented as a way to let agents act on a user’s behalf while handling delegated identity across tools and services. The post highlights using a private Entra-protected MCP server alongside Microsoft’s managed Work IQ MCP server in the same agent flow.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: What’s New in Microsoft Foundry | June 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s June 2026 update adds Claude GA and several agent-related features released between Build 2026 and the end of June. It also calls out autopilot agents, expanded Toolboxes and Routines, and Agent Optimizer entering private preview.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Toolboxes are now generally available. They provide a unified endpoint for commonly used tools in prompt agents and can also be invoked outside prompt agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: New features and Claude as agent provider preview in JetBrains IDEs
item.description:
GitHub added support for organization and enterprise agents in JetBrains IDEs, along with Copilot CLI message queueing/steering and a new agent debug logs summary view. The update also previews Claude as an agent provider in JetBrains IDEs.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview. It lets you automate reasoning-based tasks such as issue triage, CI failure analysis, and documentation updates using coding agents inside GitHub.

  • Source: GitHub
